_source: Puppet Master. Google Chrome's own .deb (not Chromium), split out of base so base installs only the libraries Chrome needs. Its managed policy (pm-sbx-chrome-policy.json) is written here too, because it only means something once Chrome is installed.
title: Google Chrome
description: The Chrome browser the sandbox shows and drives, with the policy that keeps it inside the sandbox (no password manager, no sign-in, no sync).
